svg.title: The field: cstack skills by stage
svg.desc: A Klein blue poster. Headline in white: A job stops only where it needs to. Each row is a stage from Think to Remember; each square a skill. The squares a job did not use are soft and blurred; the one it used in each stage is sharp and white, and a white line runs down through them: brief, identity-system, creative-direction, vector-master, brand-verify, learn-loop. In Look outward it does not stop: not this time.
